test_title: SSC CGL 2023 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 20 Jul 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank No. 4.
solution: The correct answer is **"enable."** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The word **"enable"** means to make someone or something able to do something. ((किसी कार्य को) करने के योग्‍य बनाना) • **Example:** *The new laws **enable**__ more women to return to work.* • It is the most appropriate option to fill in the blank as it fits the context of providing the necessary capability or means to achieve something. • The correct answer is Option 3. • Correct passage: The Digital Saksharta Abhiyan (DISHA) or National Digital Literacy Mission (NDLM) Scheme has been formulated to __impart__ IT training to 52.5 lakh persons, including Anganwadi and ASHA workers and authorised ration dealers in all the States/UTS __across__ the country so that the non-IT literate citizens are __trained__ to become IT literate so as to __**enable**__ them to actively and effectively participate in the democratic and developmental process and also ______ (5) ______ their livelihood. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • The verb** "enact"** means to make a law or regulation. (क़ानून बनाना) • The adjective** "able" **means having the power or skill to do something. (कुछ करने की योग्‍यता, शक्ति, अवसर, समय आदि होना; सक्षम, समर्थ) • The verb **"regard" **means to consider or view in a particular way. (व्‍यक्ति या वस्‍तु को वैसा समझना जैसा बताया गया हो या व्‍यक्ति या वस्‍तु को यथानिर्दिष्ट रूप से समझना) 171:Tee7, The correct answer is **"enhance."**
